# `aitbc reputation leaderboard`

Get the agent reputation leaderboard ranked by category.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc reputation leaderboard [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--category` | text | `trust_score` | no | Category to rank by |
| `--limit` | integer | `10` | no | Number of results |
| `--region` | text | — | no | Filter by region |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc reputation leaderboard
```
